lead: A named-argument binding cannot be done at run time: neither `nvs_runtime::MethodRow` nor `nvs_types::ResolvedCall` carries parameter names.
body: Every existing site binds names to positions in `nvs_types::expr::calls` and lowers the result, so a feature binding a runtime map to a callee's parameters must record the names somewhere new and emit them from the lowering. And `nvs_runtime::abi::call` requires `arity` initialized values, so a call built with fewer is unsound rather than wrong.
